title: Get started in minutes
summary: A guided Get Started wizard for new users, and long chats that don't lose their place.

highlights.title: Get Started wizard
highlights.body: New users get a short guided setup: make the AI yours, connect your tools, sign in to coding agents and build a first app with ready-made suggestions.

highlights.title: Long chats hold together
highlights.body: Long-running chats keep streaming, recover after interruptions and keep complete replies, attachments and drafts.

items.text: Chats render diagrams, and previews look better in the desktop app.
Chat in the browser matches the desktop app, composer included.
The chat rail keeps its order while a run is going.
The bot header stays put when a chat loses focus.
Hermes keeps its state when providers refresh.
Trusted apps use your connected integrations by default.
Matrix AI holds less credit for small Sonnet requests.
Private project sharing finishes setting up and explains organization limits.
Claude status and chat credit are current right after sign-up.
Providers refresh after you sign in.
ChatGPT subscriptions connected earlier keep working.
Status for custom agents that aren't tracked is hidden.
